title: Shah Rukh Khan Reclaims India's Most Valuable Celebrity Crown in Kroll Rankings
excerpt: The Bollywood superstar surpasses Virat Kohli and Ranveer Singh in Kroll's 2025 brand valuation report, capping a commercial resurgence built on 35 brand partnerships and a ₹3,017 crore Fortune India valuation.
body:
• Shah Rukh Khan tops Kroll's Celebrity Brand Valuation Report 2025, climbing from third place to reclaim the number one position with his enduring brand value.
  • Ranveer Singh holds second place at USD 162.9 million, overtaking Virat Kohli (USD 158.4 million) for the first time in the brand valuation rankings.
  • The Fortune India-Interbrand study separately valued Khan's brand at ₹3,017 crore, second only to Kohli's ₹3,542 crore in a methodology that weighs engagement, trust, and cultural influence.
  • Celebrity-endorsed advertising during IPL 2026 rose 34% year-on-year, with Khan leading all endorsers on linear television with a 10% share of ad volumes.

Shah Rukh Khan has reclaimed the top spot in Kroll's Celebrity Brand Valuation Report for 2025, climbing from third place in the previous edition to lead India's celebrity brand rankings. The report, released this week, valued India's top 25 celebrity brands at a combined USD 2 billion.

The Numbers Behind the Comeback

Khan's return to the summit displaces a hierarchy that had placed cricketer Virat Kohli and actor Ranveer Singh ahead of him in recent years. In the new rankings, Singh holds second with a brand valuation of USD 162.9 million, while Kohli drops to third at USD 158.4 million — the first time Singh has surpassed Kohli in the Kroll study.

The shift reflects more than box-office performance. Kroll's methodology factors in endorsement portfolios, social media presence, and cultural penetration. Khan represents 35 brands spanning automobiles, beverages, financial services, and home decor, including a 25-year partnership with Hyundai that Fortune India flagged as one of the longest celebrity-brand associations in the country.

"The 2026 list reflects a new era where brand equity is converted into business equity."

— Hurun Report

Dominance Across Screens

TAM Media Research data confirmed Khan's commercial reach during IPL 2026, where he emerged as the most visible celebrity endorser on linear television, accounting for 10% of all celebrity-endorsed ad volumes. Celebrity-led advertising climbed 34% compared to the previous IPL season, with endorsed commercials making up 61% of total ad volumes during live matches.

Film stars continued to dominate the advertising landscape, contributing 77% of celebrity-endorsed volumes. Khan's lead over the next-ranked endorser, Ishaan Khatter at 9%, underscored his sustained pull with advertisers even as digital platforms shift attention toward younger talent.

Two Rankings, One Trend

The Kroll report arrives alongside the Fortune India-Interbrand Most Valuable Celebrities 2026 study, which used a different methodology to rank Kohli first at ₹3,542 crore and Khan second at ₹3,017 crore. The divergence highlights how different metrics — endorsement revenue versus audience engagement and trust — can produce different hierarchies, but Khan features at or near the top of both.

The Fortune India study evaluated factors including audience engagement, trust, affinity, distinctiveness, and cross-platform influence, marking a shift from older models that focused primarily on endorsement income or box-office success.

The Wealth Behind the Brand

Khan's commercial standing is matched by his financial trajectory. The Hurun Global Rich List 2026 placed him at a net worth of USD 1.3 billion, attributed to Red Chillies Entertainment, a majority stake in the Kolkata Knight Riders franchise — now valued at over USD 1.1 billion — and an extensive portfolio of brand ownership stakes.

His next major release, King, is among the most anticipated Indian films in production. Ranveer Singh, riding the Dhurandhar franchise's Rs 3,000-crore global box office, and Kohli, still India's most followed athlete, remain close competitors. But for now, Khan's combination of legacy, commercial breadth, and global audience reach has put him back on top.
